Definition: from G2596 and G2808; to shut down (in a dungeon), i.e. incarcerate:--shut up.
BiblicalUsage: Paul shut up the saints in prison, and Herod added John to his other evils by shutting him up too.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the prison door is the world's answer to a voice it cannot silence.
